question: Workers who own and operate an enterprise to earn their livelihood are known as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seif-employed.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Workers who own and operate an enterprise to earn their livelihood are known as **self-employed workers**
 
• Self-employment is different from employment in several ways. 
 
• Self-employed people own their own businesses and are responsible for their own finances. 
 
• They set their own hours and work in their own way. 
 
• They also keep all of the money that they earn.
